title: Concept: Package source backed by a folder
description: nuget.config declares a source value of the `file:` scheme, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a source value of the `file:` scheme.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a source value of the `file:` scheme.
